baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active feminine plural ٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ is intensified by the cognate accusative سَبْحًا, repeating س ب ح across both focus words.
baseline_models.mechanism: The running/swimming branch supplies sustained self-propelled passage through water, air, or a celestial course; the doubled root makes manner and extent, rather than destination, the foreground.

activation_trace.role: Swimming and running through water, air, or a celestial course supplies the literal image of extended fluid traversal.

changed_reading.before: Unspecified feminine agents perform an action called sabh.
changed_reading.after: The agents propel themselves in a sustained, fluid course through a medium that permits continuous motion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both ٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ and سَبْحًا carry the focus root س ب ح, whose inventory includes devotional tasbih and declaring transcendence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Worshipful tasbih and the act of declaring freedom from defect can fill the same emphatic construction, making the agents' defining activity sustained praise and transcendence rather than locomotion alone.

activation_trace.role: Tasbih as prayer, remembrance, worship, and gratitude supplies the devotional performance.
Declaring transcendence and freedom from defect supplies the content and separating force of that performance.

changed_reading.after: The clause can depict agents wholly occupied in emphatic worship that declares divine transcendence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognate pair in 79:3 can activate the س ب ح branch of spacious going, coming, livelihood, and wide-ranging movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sabh is construed as ample operational range: the agents have room to go out, return, and act across distance without the clause specifying a literal liquid medium.

activation_trace.role: Spacious going and coming for livelihood supplies broad operational range as the function of sabh.

changed_reading.before: The agents swim in an unspecified medium.
changed_reading.after: The agents range widely and freely, with mobility itself functioning as capacity for work.

context_deltas.mechanism: Placed between release or transfer and overtaking, then followed by outcome-aware administration, the swimming becomes the transit phase of a purposeful procession: disengagement opens movement, sustained traversal develops momentum, precedence secures position, and management executes the task.

activation_trace.role: Continuous swimming or running supplies the central transit phase.
Departure and transfer from one place to another supplies release into the transit phase.
Advancing and racing supplies the next phase, turning traversal into momentum toward precedence.
Managing with regard to outcomes supplies purpose and completion to the movement sequence.

structural_cues: 79:1-4 repeat feminine active participles with cognate accusatives, while the fā-openings of 79:4-5 make 79:3 a hinge before precedence and administration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transfer, traversal, precedence, and outcome-aware management; I supply the directional arrow that each enables the next. A live alternative is that the oath-images are coordinated but independent rather than phases of one operation.

changed_reading.after: Their sabh is a mission's middle phase: released agents enter sustained transit, gain precedence, and arrive able to administer an outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later severe shaking and heart-flutter sharpen sabh by contrast: all are motion, but swimming is medium-responsive and controlled whereas convulsion is involuntary and destabilizing.

activation_trace.role: Sustained swimming supplies coordinated motion through rather than collapse under a medium.
Severe disturbance supplies uncontrolled macro-scale motion as a foil to the swimmers' coordinated course.
Agitation and heart-throbbing supplies uncontrolled inner motion as the second foil.

structural_cues: The subject of motion shifts after the opening agents: 79:6 assigns disturbance to the convulsing event and 79:8 assigns flutter to hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three different motion images; I infer that their juxtaposition marks control versus loss of control, not merely rising intensity. The live alternative is that all three contribute equally to one atmosphere of speed and agitation.

changed_reading.after: Sabh is poised, controlled motion that carries its agents through conditions under which worlds and hearts lose stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sacred purity, self-purification, and gentle guidance toward a true path turn the focus's devotional branches into a route: tasbih is not only utterance but progressive movement through purification toward rightly directed worship.

activation_trace.role: Tasbih as worship, prayer, and remembrance supplies the devotional action that moves along the course.
Declaring transcendence and freedom from defect supplies the purifying orientation of that devotion.
Purity and sanctification supply the consecrated starting environment for the course.
Purity and rectitude supply the requested transformation along the course.
Gentle direction to the path and truth supplies guidance and destination rather than undirected devotion.

structural_cues: The command to go in 79:17 and the repeated directional إِلَىٰ in 79:17-19 make the purification exchange explicitly route-shaped.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sacredness, purification, guidance, and directional grammar; I infer that the devotional sense of sabh can be enacted as progress along that route. The live alternative is static vocal praise with no locomotor metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The agents emphatically praise and declare transcendence.
changed_reading.after: Their tasbih is a guided purificatory course in which worship and directed movement coincide.

context_deltas.mechanism: The built and regularized sky, together with its night and clear daylight, supplies a structured arena and observable cycle for the focus branch that explicitly includes celestial running; the swimmers become plausible celestial coursers rather than generic movers.

activation_trace.role: Running through air and the motion of stars in a celestial course supplies the focus's cosmic locomotion.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the medium of the celestial course.
Construction by joining parts supplies an articulated arena rather than empty, random space.
Straightness and completion supply regularity to the arena and its courses.
Night and its darkness supply one visible phase of the sky's recurring course.
The brightness and clarity of morning supply the counter-phase by which ordered celestial passage becomes perceptible.

structural_cues: The feminine singular pronoun in 79:27-29 continuously binds building, raising, regularizing, darkening, and bringing out brightness to the sky.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a constructed, regularized sky and a night-brightness alternation; I infer that this alternation displays the course of celestial swimmers. Aquatic, devotional, and non-celestial agents remain live alternatives.

changed_reading.before: The agents could be any swimmers in any medium.
changed_reading.after: They can be celestial coursers moving regularly through a made and ordered sky whose cycles reveal their passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's spacious going is recast as accountable range: purposeful pursuit leaves a remembered course, preference selects its object, and restraint prevents the living self from following its inclination. Mobility therefore requires steering, not merely capacity or speed.

activation_trace.role: Spacious going, coming, and livelihood supplies the mobile field whose use becomes morally accountable.
Purposeful movement toward an object supplies a course that can later be remembered and assessed.
Preferring one thing by choice supplies selection of the course's governing object.
Checking and restraining an act supplies active course correction.
The living self supplies the traveler whose own momentum must be governed.
The self's inclination supplies a pull capable of diverting spacious movement from its proper course.

structural_cues: 79:35 makes what a person pursued an object of recollection, and 79:37-41 divides outcomes between transgressive preference and restraint of the self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful pursuit, preference, a living self, restraint, and inclination; I infer a navigational relation in which restraint steers the ranging capacity activated by sabh. The opening agents need not themselves be the humans judged later, so a purely operational reading remains live.

changed_reading.before: Wide-ranging movement is neutral capacity for work.
changed_reading.after: Sabh can imply disciplined range: movement has a chosen course, leaves an accountable wake, and succeeds only when its inner pull is governed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A ship's anchorage and an ultimate endpoint place a terminal boundary around the focus's swimming: fluid motion is not endless drift but transit held within an assigned destination structure.

activation_trace.role: Swimming supplies continuous transit before any stopping point is visible.
A ship's stopping and anchorage supplies the image of motion ending at a fixed station.
The limit at which a thing ends supplies the governing terminus beyond the anchorage question.

structural_cues: The closing question asks when the Hour reaches its anchorage, the response assigns its endpoint to the Lord, and 79:46 compresses experienced duration between evening and morning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a maritime stopping image and an ultimate endpoint; I infer that they retrospectively bound the opening swimming within one transit schema. The live alternative is that the Hour's anchorage has no referential connection to the opening agents.

changed_reading.before: The swimmers are defined by ongoing motion without a stated destination.
changed_reading.after: Their sabh can be heard as bounded transit: sustained movement remains under destination authority and tends toward an assigned anchorage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 79:3 grammatically presents active feminine plural swimmers while 79:31 presents water, not an explicit identification of those swimmers. It remains anchored in the focus's literal aquatic branch and the later emergence of abundant water against fixed anchorage; downstream prose should present it only as a hydrological or water-borne activation, never as a settled lexical referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The س ب ح branch in ٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًا explicitly includes swimming in water.

activation_trace.role: Literal swimming in water supplies the aquatic anchor for mobile carriers or flows.
Passage to the outside supplies water's emergence into a traversable terrestrial circuit.
The appearance and abundance of water supplies the literal medium activated by the focus branch.
Firm fixation supplies a stable counter-pole against which mobile water or water-borne agents can be imagined.

changed_reading.before: The swimmers traverse an unspecified medium.
changed_reading.after: They may be imagined as mobile water-borne carriers or flows crossing the provisioned earth between emergence and fixed landforms.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the prayer-bead branch is nominal and material while the focus syntax presents active agents in emphatic action. It remains rooted in an attested focus branch and is activated by succession, recurrence, and numerical oneness; downstream prose should preserve it only as a beadlike analogy for serial motion or counted devotion, not identify the agents as literal beads.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory for س ب ح includes prayer beads used to count tasbih, while the repeated focus root can support iterative performance.

activation_trace.role: Prayer beads used for counting tasbih supply a material image of units moving serially through repeated devotion.
Succession and continuity supply one-after-another ordering for the units.
Return and repetition supply the recurring action of a counted sequence.
Numerical oneness supplies discrete unitization within the sequence.

changed_reading.before: The agents move in one continuous sweep.
changed_reading.after: Their motion can be pictured as a counted procession, discrete units advancing one after another like beads through a repeated act.

strongest_changes: The opening sequence turns generic swimming into the transit phase of a release-to-precedence-to-administration process.
The creation block activates the focus branch's celestial scope, placing ordered coursers in a built and regularized sky.
The closing anchorage and endpoint recast apparently open-ended swimming as bounded transit under destination authority.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled focus root remained genuinely polysemous across the whole surah: physical traversal, devotional purification, cosmic course, operational range, and even contained material analogies changed independently rather than collapsing into one referent.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine plural agents remain unidentified, so process structure is firmer than referent assignment.
The controlled-motion contrast may be rhetorical juxtaposition rather than a designed opposition.
The hydrological and beadlike activations are branch-anchored analogies but remain form-distant and should not be promoted without qualification.
